nodes.description: Public address state variable in Migrations storing the deployer, used by the restricted modifier.
Public uint256 state variable in Migrations tracking the last completed migration number.
Constructor of Migrations that assigns owner = msg.sender, giving deployer privileges.
Restricted function in Migrations that writes the completed migration number to state.
Restricted function in Migrations that casts an address to a Migrations contract and calls setCompleted externally.
Untrusted caller identity used for ownership checks and authorization throughout the contracts.
External call to upgraded.setCompleted(local state) on an attacker-supplied address, allowing state change before/after arbitrary code execution.
Address parameter of upgrade used to instantiate an attacker-controllable Migrations contract.
uint256 parameter of setCompleted written directly into last_completed_migration.
Private mapping of address to token balance in ERC20, mutated in _transfer/_mint/_burn.
Private nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance in ERC20.
Private uint256 total token supply in ERC20, mutated by _mint and _burn.
Internal ERC20 function moving balances between two addresses and emitting Transfer.
Internal ERC20 function creating tokens and increasing _totalSupply and the target balance.
Internal ERC20 function destroying tokens and decreasing balance and _totalSupply.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and reduces allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve that grants allowance through _approve.
Internal ERC20 function writing _allowances for an owner/spender pair.
Private Roles.Role storage tracking granted minters in MinterRole.
Public onlyMinter function adding a new minter to _minters.
Public function removing msg.sender from the minter role.
Context helper returning msg.sender, used as the authorization subject for ERC20 operations.
Unrestricted public mint in ERC20Mock that mints arbitrary tokens to any account.
Unrestricted public burn in ERC20Mock that destroys tokens from any account.
Public wrapper in ERC20Mock exposing internal _transfer with arbitrary from/to.
Public wrapper in ERC20Mock exposing internal _approve for arbitrary owner/spender.
Address parameter used by mint/burn and balanceOf to identify the affected token holder.
uint256 parameter controlling how many tokens are created, destroyed or moved.
Address parameter of transfer/token transfers receiving the moved tokens.
Address parameter of transferFrom/_transfer that tokens are taken from.
Address parameter granted allowance in approve/_approve.
Local Migrations instance cast from new_address, the target of the external setCompleted call.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the owner inside the Migrations constructor, establishing privileged authority from an untrusted address.
The untrusted msg.sender value is written directly into the owner state variable.
The restricted modifier gates setCompleted on msg.sender == owner, so access to this state writer depends on an untrusted caller.
setCompleted writes the supplied value into last_completed_migration state.
The completed parameter flows directly into the last_completed_migration state variable.
The completed parameter is the input consumed by setCompleted.
The new_address parameter is the input to upgrade.
upgrade performs an external call to an arbitrary contract address, handing control to untrusted code.
The attacker-supplied new_address parameter determines the callee of the external call.
The local upgraded instance performs the external setCompleted call, invoking untrusted code before state is finalized.
The last_completed_migration state value is passed as the argument of the external call.
upgrade assigns new_address to the local upgraded variable used for the external invocation.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender used as the authorization subject.
_msgSender supplies the from-address for ERC20 transfer.
_msgSender supplies the spender identity for the allowance deduction in transferFrom.
_msgSender supplies the owner for the allowance created by approve.
_msgSender is checked in the onlyMinter modifier before addMinter executes.
_msgSender determines which account renounces the minter role.
Public transfer invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom first invokes _transfer to move tokens.
transferFrom invokes _approve to deduct the spent allowance.
approve invokes the internal _approve routine to set allowances.
_transfer mutates the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_mint credits the target account balance in _balances.
_burn debits the account balance in _balances.
_burn reduces the _totalSupply state variable.
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowances mapping.
addMinter grants role membership in the _minters role state.
renounceMinter revokes role membership in the _minters role state.
The onlyMinter guard validates _msgSender before privileged minter administration is allowed.
Any msg.sender can call the unrestricted ERC20Mock.mint with no authorization check.
Any msg.sender can call the unrestricted ERC20Mock.burn, destroying tokens from arbitrary accounts.
ERC20Mock.mint delegates token creation to the internal _mint.
ERC20Mock.burn delegates token destruction to the internal _burn.
transferInternal exposes the internal _transfer to any caller for arbitrary from/to.
approveInternal exposes the internal _approve to any caller for arbitrary owner/spender.
The account parameter is the recipient of newly minted tokens in _mint.
The account parameter is the mint target passed into ERC20Mock.mint.
The account parameter is the burn source passed into ERC20Mock.burn.
The amount parameter determines the integer quantity added in _mint.
The amount parameter drives how many tokens ERC20Mock.mint creates.
The amount parameter drives how many tokens ERC20Mock.burn destroys.
The recipient parameter receives tokens in transfer.
The sender parameter is the debited account inside _transfer.
The sender parameter identifies whose allowance and balance transferFrom consumes.
The spender parameter is granted allowance by approve.
The spender parameter indexes the _allowances mapping in _approve.

normalization_plan.reason: The new_address parameter exists only as the input to upgrade and should be folded into that function node.
The completed parameter is only meaningful as the argument of setCompleted and merges into it.
The account parameter is a temporary alias for the mint target and merges into the mint function node.
The amount parameter only drives arithmetic in the minting routine and merges into _mint.
The recipient parameter is a transient input of transfer and merges into the transfer function node.
The sender parameter is a transient input of the transfer routine and merges into _transfer.
The spender parameter is a transient allowance index and merges into the _approve function node.
The upgraded local variable is only used to perform the external call and merges into the unsafe_operation node.
